mapper.sql: p.id, p.category_id, p.name, p.image, p.price, p.stock, p.sales, p.description, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time, c.name AS category_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (category_id, name, image, price, stock, sales, description, status) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{image}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{sales}, #{description}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET stock = stock - #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id} AND stock >= #{quantity}
UPDATE product SET sales = sales + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET stock = stock + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(p.id) AS num FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY p.category_id, c.name
